{"description":"Start a command that keeps running in the background while you go on working, such as a dev server, a file watcher or an interactive program, and return its id and what it printed so far. It runs in your workspace as run's commands do, under the same limits. Use run for a command that finishes. Give ready, text the program prints once it is up such as \"Listening on\", to wait for it: the result then says whether it appeared or the command exited first. Read its output with read_process, give it input with write_process, and stop it with stop_process once you are done with it. Every process is stopped when you give your final reply, before your work is checked, and when your attempt ends; one runs for at most 30 minutes, and at most 4 run at once. Its input and output are pipes, not a terminal: a program that buffers its output may need a flag such as python -u. Commands you run with run reach the ports a process listens on, at localhost, while it runs: start a server, then test it with run. Give port, the port it listens on, to wait until it does. Nothing outside your workspace reaches them, and another attempt's server on the same port is another server.","input_schema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"command":{"description":"The command, run with bash -c.","type":"string"},"port":{"description":"A TCP port the program listens on once it is up, to wait for: with ready too, until both hold.","type":"integer"},"ready":{"description":"Text the program prints once it is ready, to wait for. Without it the result comes after about a second.","type":"string"},"timeout_s":{"description":"Seconds to wait for ready or port. Default 30, at most 120.","type":"integer"}},"required":["command"],"type":"object"},"name":"start_process","strict":true}
{"description":"Read what a process printed since you last read it (its standard output and error together), and whether it is still running or how it ended. Very long output keeps its start and end.","input_schema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"id":{"description":"The id start_process returned.","type":"string"},"wait_s":{"description":"Seconds to wait for output when there is none yet. Default 0, at most 30.","type":"integer"}},"required":["id"],"type":"object"},"name":"read_process","strict":true}
{"description":"Write text to a running process's standard input; end a line with \\n. Read its answer with read_process. Fails once the process has ended.","input_schema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"close":{"description":"Close its input after the text, as at the end of a file. Default false.","type":"boolean"},"id":{"description":"The id start_process returned.","type":"string"},"input":{"description":"The text, at most 64 KiB.","type":"string"}},"required":["id","input"],"type":"object"},"name":"write_process","strict":true}
